description: Retrieve the passages of Balford's published engineering material that match a query, without writing an answer. Use this to check what Balford has actually published on a topic, to gather source URLs for a citation, or to ground your own reasoning. Costs no model tokens. Answers are assembled from Balford's own published engineering material and cite the page each claim came from. Nothing is quoted that is not already public on balford.net. This is not a quotation, a certification claim, or a dimensional acceptance.

limit.description: Maximum number of passages to return. Default 6, maximum 12.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. 'thinning deep drawing 0.35 mm wall' or 'PPAP level 3'.

name: search_balford_material

quality.description: strong, thin, or none — how well the material covers the query.

title: Search Balford's published engineering material
